The '''''Strikefast''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]].

==History==
Its first appearance was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], under the command of [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]]. The vessel was chasing [[Booster Terrik]] when it came upon a [[Unidentified planet (Thrawn's exile)/Legends|world]] where a local inhabitant destroyed the landing party's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIEs]] and shuttles using the native flora and fauna. Impressed, Parck took the alien&mdash;[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]&mdash;back to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
